text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon the intrusion.
I'm... Still in Love."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“...Hehe.
You actually waited for me, didn't you...?”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"To be able to walk this path together from here on...
makes me so happy...
I look forward to working with you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
